headline: Boom/bust player projections
method_note: NFL model trained on 2024-25 after a locked 2024-to-2025 holdout test. These are preseason generic baselines, not Week 1 matchup projections. No betting edge is claimed.

bust_model.definition: Under 30 receiving yards AND under 50% of prior six-game mean among players averaging at least 4 targets per game

cfb_status: CFB receiving projections withheld: 2024 target-player fields were materially incomplete versus 2025 and have not been repaired to a consistent source yet.

sportsbook.label: Research only
sportsbook.note: Week 1 FanDuel player props will be added only from the publisher’s existing audited capture when posted; no second scraper and no current lines invented.
